name: decide
description: Manual-only decision procedures. Each skill runs one published protocol against a judgment already on the table, structuring it without making it. Ships /reversible (one-way and two-way doors), /options (WRAP widening), /tradeoff (Kepner-Tregoe and Pugh), /hypotheses (ACH), /premortem (Klein), /redteam (adversarial review), /fermi (order-of-magnitude estimation), /base-rate (reference class forecasting), /quit (kill criteria), and /adr (Nygard decision records).
